items.summary: Recommendation: approve only the reversible, zero-external-spend SEO test on aliencouncil.com and keep broader affiliate expansion bounded. The 30-day baseline is 77 impressions, position 5.5, 0 clicks, 0 sessions, and 0 conversions; the 2026-09-21 revenue window records 10 site clicks and $0 attributed commission. Revenue impact, contribution margin, and ROI are therefore unproven. AI spend was $940.70 across the 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-25 window, while no monthly budget or fixed-cost baseline is provided. Do not scale work from impressions, clicks, or aggregate $4.92 commission.

The minimum finance measurement before any monetization expansion is page/site-level linkage of eligible sessions, affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, AI cost, and directly attributable infrastructure cost over the same dated window. Aggregate provider revenue must remain unassigned. Contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable until those cost fields and experiment exposure are available.
